Same TSSOP5/SOT353 package and pinout as the 74LVC1G32GW. JLCPCB C179324: stockCount 952, canPresaleNumber 949, expand (vendors.py jlcpcb C179324, 2026-09-28T13:47:12Z). Not considered. It is push-pull and states its maximum hysteresis. Its band is 183 mV, between P2's rank 1 (169 mV) and rank 2 (198 mV). From SLVSES2J (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tlv809e.pdf, read 2026-09-28T13:49:51Z): VIT- 3.08 V, accuracy +/-2 % at -40 to 125 degC, so 3.018 V to 3.142 V. VHYS 0.9 % to 1.5 % of VIT-, so the release is at most 3.142 x 1.015 = 3.189 V, at or below 3.201 V. The band from 3.018 V to 3.201 V is 183 mV. The threshold minimum is above 2.0 V and 1.65 V. Push-pull active-low output; VPOR 700 mV maximum. Delay variant A, tD 130 ms to 270 ms, meets V43. VDD 1.7 V to 6 V. JLCPCB C2860914: stockCount 851, canPresaleNumber 848 (13:50:27Z). TPS3808G01 (adjustable) has 2 % accuracy and 3 % maximum hysteresis (SBVS050N, read 13:49:53Z), which is wider than the TPS3808G33.

With no LED current it is open, and it has no register. VOM1271, document 83469 Rev. 1.9 (https://www.vishay.com/docs/83469/vom1271.pdf, read 2026-09-28T13:54:56Z): VOC 7.8 V minimum at IF 10 mA; ISC 6 uA minimum, 15 uA typical; integrated fast turn-off; toff 65 us typical at CL 200 pF, no maximum. missed_functions.function: timing network (C and R of the monostable)
missed_functions.why: IOBoard.md@c25aa86:185 names it: C in a dielectric with a stated temperature coefficient, and R from E96, 50 kOhm to 150 kOhm, set on test. C's drift enters the same window budget as V36 and V37. P2 has no entry. Research.md:28 puts passives in round 2, and the R3 row does not name the timing capacitor. If P6 marks it not round 1, no gap remains.

missed_functions.function: inverter on an active-low output enable
missed_functions.why: IOBoard.md@c25aa86:192 (Powered-off isolation, sources PR #167, R3, R4) requires I_off or a 4.7 kOhm series resistor from the enable node. P2 lists only the trigger-path inverter. The output buffer is R4's choice (R4 row), so this inverter exists only if R4 picks a buffer with an active-low enable. R3 or R4 must own it; nothing on the page assigns it.

missed_functions.function: heartbeat-node series resistors, links and fail-safe pull-downs
missed_functions.why: IOBoard.md@c25aa86:191 and :193 name the 100 kOhm pull-downs on the trigger input, each OR input and the enable node, the 4.7 kOhm series resistors, and the removable links in the display and trigger branches. P2 has no entry. Research.md:28 puts passives and connectors in round 2, so these are not round 1 unless P6 decides otherwise.
